stories.title: The 10 MLB players who leveled up this season -- and how it changed their teams' fortunes
stories.summary: From Cam Schlittler to Miz and PCA, these players took their games to new heights in 2026 -- and their clubs found success because of it.

stories.title: Sources: Bears, Swift agree to $33.75M extension
stories.summary: The Chicago Bears and RB D'Andre Swift have reached an agreement on a 3-year, $33.75 million extension that includes $27.5M guaranteed, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

stories.title: Falcons' Tagovailoa out, Rush to start vs. Steelers
stories.summary: The Falcons will start backup Cooper Rush at quarterback in Sunday's opener against the Steelers after ruling starter Tua Tagovailoa out with an oblique injury.

stories.title: 'Gonna let them do them': Cunningham ignoring Kanter Freedom, White
stories.summary: Sophie Cunningham says she is focusing on the Fever's remaining games and not the commotion around Enes Kanter Freedom and Royce White declaring for the WNBA draft.

stories.title: Wrexham suffer heaviest loss under Reynolds, Mac in West Ham rout
stories.summary: Wrexham suffered their heaviest defeat under the ownership of Ryan Reynolds and Rob Mac as West Ham ran rampant in a 6-0 rout on Friday.
